01 — Start here

Which service does my car actually need?

Most jobs here are a combination — correction, then protection. Answer three steps and the studio will tell you honestly what your car needs, and what it doesn't.

1. Send photos

Tell us the car, its condition and how you use it. Photos of the paint help — most cars benefit from correction plus one form of protection.

→

Paint depth readings before anything touches the car — original paint gets a measured, conservative approach, especially on classics and collector cars.

03 — The studio

A workshop, not a car wash

Auto Attention has worked from Richmond since 2015. Correction, coating and PPF happen at the Richmond studio, where light, dust and temperature are controlled — because paint depth readings and film adhesion don't forgive a bad environment.

Detailing and maintenance work can be mobile across Melbourne, where you need power, a tap and an undercover area. The studio jobs stay in the studio. That's a deliberate choice, not a limitation.

  • Paint depth readings before anything touches original paint
  • Measured, conservative approach on classics and restoration projects
  • Correction + protection combinations — the most common job: correction, front PPF, then ceramic over the whole car including the film
  • Gift vouchers in $350 and $650 denominations

07 — FAQ

Straight answers

Which service does my car actually need?

It depends on the car's condition and how you use it. As a rule: correction fixes what's wrong, ceramic coating keeps it clean and glossy, and PPF stops physical damage. Most cars benefit from correction plus one form of protection. Send photos and the studio will tell you honestly.

Do you offer mobile services across Melbourne?

Yes, for detailing and maintenance work — the studio needs power, a tap and an undercover area. Paint correction, ceramic coating and PPF are done at the Richmond studio, where conditions are controlled.

How far in advance do I need to book?

Detailing can often be accommodated within a week. Correction, coating and PPF bookings typically run two to four weeks out, as those jobs occupy a bay for several days.

Do you work on classic and collector cars?

Extensively. Air-cooled Porsches, Ferraris, restoration projects and concours entrants are core work. Original paint gets a measured, conservative approach and paint depth readings before anything touches it.

Can I combine multiple services?

Almost every job is a combination. The most common package is paint correction, then PPF on the front end, then a ceramic coating over the whole car including the film.
